register_all_mmpretrain_modules: register all mmpretrain modules including datasets, models, engine, evaluation, structures, and visualization into registries
init_default_scope_mmpretrain: initialize the mmpretrain default scope so all registries build modules from mmpretrain's registry node
register_modules_without_default_scope: register all mmpretrain modules without initializing the default scope by setting init_default_scope to False
handle_scope_name_conflict: handle scope name conflicts by creating a timestamped mmpretrain instance when the current scope is not mmpretrain
check_current_default_scope: check the current default scope instance and warn if it is not set to mmpretrain
